free_tier.stated: Free plan: 10 GB/day of download traffic, no storage quota published. Paid Premium Max: 100 GB/day. Both are download-traffic products, not storage products.

egress.terms: Free = slow speed plus 10 GB/day cap; premium = 100 GB/day on Max. Egress is the thing being sold, so free egress is structurally absent.

chaining: None — with egress sold per day, multiplying accounts multiplies a metered cost structure.
limits_note: Free 10 GB/day; Premium Max 100 GB/day; no simultaneous downloads on free. TezFiles pricing shown as $35.87/$27.98 per month, 100 GB/day on Max.
reliability_note: TezFiles serves an interstitial 'Check your browser settings. Make sure JavaScript is enabled' to plain fetchers, so only the firecrawl-pinned read gets the plan table.

evidence.proved: returns the JS interstitial, not content
